# Tech Syndicate Solutions

> Tech Syndicate Solutions is a software studio based in Puducherry, India. We build SaaS platforms, business websites and mobile apps end to end.

- Website: https://rasheedrahman.github.io/tech-syndicate-solutions/

## Team
- Mohamed Rasheed Rahman — Full-Stack & Mobile Developer (React, FastAPI, Flutter, AWS)
- Gokul B — Creative Developer, Next.js & 3D web experiences (also SEO, GEO, AEO)

## Services
- Web applications: React and Next.js dashboards, POS systems and internal tools
- Mobile apps: cross-platform Flutter apps shipped to Google Play and the App Store
- Backend and APIs: FastAPI, Node.js and GraphQL with PostgreSQL or MongoDB
- Cloud and DevOps: AWS S3, CloudFront, ECS, ECR and Docker
- 3D and motion: Three.js and GSAP scroll experiences
- SEO, GEO and AEO: schema, speed and AI-search visibility
